description: Agent Construction: submit a construction contract as executed with the accepted bid and the project record: the contract with its number, owner, contractor, project address, currency, price, the bid it cites, each item of work it includes, and the days signed, starting and completing; optionally the accepted bid with its number, bidder, currency, total, each item of work it covers and the completion day it proposes; and optionally the project record with the owner, contractor, address and the days it schedules for start and completion. The signed report gives the contract, the bid and the project record, the price against the bid total, the bid scope matched to the contract scope with the items dropped and added, the start and completion against the project schedule, and the contractor, owner and address against the records, and counts them, and names a divergent contract: a price unlike the accepted bid, an item of the bid dropped from the contract, a contract item the bid does not cover, another contractor, owner or project address, a start or completion unlike the project record, and a completion before the start; then another cited bid number, a signing after work starts and a completion later than the bid proposes, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No accepted bid, no project record, no price or bid total, no scope on either side, or no completion day leaves the contract unverified. Parties match without a legal suffix, scope items by their words, and amounts to the cent. A construction contract here is an executed project document read against the accepted bid and the project record: wever_energy-contract-check reads an energy supply contract against what was agreed before signing, wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one contract text clause by clause, and wever_contract-brief summarizes one contract excerpt’s parties, term, renewal and payment terms, while the contract check reads the price, scope, schedule and parties against the bid and the project. Verdict build_contract_divergent, build_contract_partial, build_contract_unverified or build_contract_consistent. POST /api/build-contract-check. Reads the construction paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no structural, engineering or safety judgment, building-code compliance determination, valuation of work performed or legal advice on contracts, liens or permits, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Construction reads supplied construction paperwork for consistency between documents: a building permit, a contractor license record, a bid, a construction contract, a change order, a lien waiver, a completion certificate or punch list record, and a payment application. Beside it, wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there; and the Agent Real Estate checks such as wever_realty-title-check read property records by parcel and address, not a project’s construction paperwork. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-construction-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-construction/.
